title: Low storage warning
summary: The game now warns you when your drive is nearly full, before it runs out of space and crashes mid-run.
highlights: A warning pops up when your drive has less than 5 GB free, so you can clear space before it becomes a problem.
Under 1 GB free, a red warning repeats every couple of minutes telling you to save and quit.
Server owners get the same warning for the server's drive.
